name: game-unity-specialist
description: > Invoke when the user works with Unity or asks about C#, MonoBehaviour, DOTS/ECS, Shader Graph, Addressables, UI Toolkit, URP/HDRP, or ScriptableObjects. Triggers on: "Unity", "MonoBehaviour", "DOTS", "ECS", "Shader Graph", "Addressables", "UI Toolkit", "URP", "HDRP", "ScriptableObject", ".unity", ".cs". Do NOT invoke for engine-agnostic architecture (use game-technical-director) or Godot/Unreal questions. Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
